serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Here we are.
You: For a place made in a short notice, it looks pretty nice, wouldn’t you think?
Bot: There’s a lot of people here and I don’t like these little humans, they are unpredictable and fall over easily.
You: You mean kids? Give them a break, they just learned how to walk and you want them to ice skate well.
You: We will see how good you will be at it.
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Let me remind you that I’m a sexbot. Thanks to my many sensors and actuators I will master this ice skating in no time.
You: Oh yeah? I ice skated before, we will see if you will be any better.
You: Let’s rent some skates and go. I hope you remember your shoe size.
Bot: Of course!
